About this Project

This dashboard summarizes the spatial analysis main results of the report A Just Vision for Community-Centered Urban Agriculture in Sunset Park. The project was developed as a partnership between the NYC Climate Justice Hub and UPROSE.

All data used for the project is public and available at the following sites:

  • NYC Open Data
  • ZoLA
  • Department of Environmental Protection
  • Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA)
  • MapPLUTO
  • Shadow data available at: https://osf.io
